beats.say: A million seconds is eleven and a half days. A billion seconds is almost thirty two years.
Start with one second and add a zero every step. A thousand seconds: under seventeen minutes.
A million seconds: eleven and a half days.
A billion seconds: thirty one point seven years.
A trillion seconds: thirty one thousand, six hundred and eighty eight years. Before the Great Pyramid was built.
Ten trillion: before the oldest known fossils of our own species.
Sixteen zeros: about three hundred and seventeen million years. Long before the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs.
Eighteen zeros, a quintillion seconds: thirty one point seven billion years. The universe is only thirteen point eight.
So you turn one billion seconds old at thirty one years and eight months. Mark the date.

title: A billion seconds is 31.7 years. A quintillion is older than the universe
caption: Add a zero to the seconds every step. 1,000 seconds: 16.7 minutes. 1 million seconds: 11.6 days. 1 billion seconds: 31.7 years. 1 trillion seconds: 31,688 years, before the Great Pyramid of Giza was begun (about 2560 BCE). 10 trillion: 316,881 years, before the oldest known Homo sapiens fossils (about 300,000 years old). 10^16 seconds: 316.9 million years, before the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs (66 million years ago). 10^18 seconds, a quintillion: 31.7 billion years, about 2.3 times the age of the universe (13.8 billion years). You turn 1 billion seconds old at about 31 years and 8 months. Years here are 365.25 days.
